patients.label: 44-year-old African American man with treatment-resistant schizophrenia and seizure disorder; clozapine stopped after DVT/PE, relapse, then xanomeline–trospium plus olanzapine
attribution_limitations: Duration of clozapine remission: main text says 26 years; abstract and discussion say "over 25 years" / "more than 25 years".

Conclusion states "the resolution of positive symptoms" while case narrative records persisting attenuated paranoid ideation (June 17), mild paranoid ideation (May 20) and occasional self-talk (August 26).
Absence of conventional VTE risk factors is asserted by the authors without listing which risk factors were assessed; the site/laterality of the DVT is not stated beyond right leg symptoms.

Causality between clozapine and the VTE/PE is attributed by the authors ("known association") and cannot be established from a single case; improvement on xanomeline–trospium plus olanzapine is likewise an author attribution.

The patient's mother was hospitalized for a nephrectomy at the time of the August 26 telehealth session; this is a family member event, not a patient fact. Blood culture results and the empiric antibiotic indication are not reported.

Abstract says aripiprazole was "titrated to 15 mg/day" before olanzapine augmentation, whereas the case text escalates it to 20 mg (April 2024) and 30 mg (by October 2024) and the discussion says "titration to 30 mg/day".
